MEFTACARD Studio / Website support

Website support and maintenance, so your site keeps working

A website is not finished on launch day. Plugins need updates, security holes appear, content goes out of date and pages slow down over time. When nobody looks after it, the site eventually breaks, gets hacked or quietly drops in Google.

Our website support plans keep your site updated, backed up, secure and fast, and give you a team to make changes whenever you need them. We support sites we built and sites built by others, all online, with clear response times.

Common website maintenance mistakes

Never updating plugins

Outdated plugins are the most common way sites get hacked. We update on a schedule after testing.

Backups on the same server

If the server fails, the backup goes with it. We store backups off-site.

Updating directly on the live site

An untested update can take the site down. We test first.

Nobody watching uptime

Many owners find out the site is down from a customer. Monitoring alerts us within minutes.

Shared admin passwords

Everyone using one login makes it impossible to control access. We set up individual accounts with the right permissions.

How much does website support cost?

Every new site includes support after launch: 30 days on Local, 60 days on Trade & Export and 24/7 support with a 99.9% uptime commitment on Enterprise. After that, or for an existing site, a monthly care plan is quoted based on the size of the site and how many changes you need. Payment is in Tether (USDT), and you can cancel any month.

What affects the cost of website support

  • Size of the site and number of plugins
  • Whether it is an online store with orders
  • How many content changes you need each month
  • Required response time
  • Current condition of the site and hosting

Questions

Do you support websites you did not build?

Yes. We start with a health check of your current site and take over updates, backups and changes.

How fast do you respond?

Normal requests are handled within one business day. Enterprise clients get 24/7 support with a 15-minute response for critical incidents.

Which platforms do you support?

Mainly WordPress, WooCommerce and custom HTML sites. Ask us about other platforms.

What happens if my site gets hacked?

We clean it, restore from a backup where needed, close the hole that was used and harden the site.

Can I cancel the plan?

Yes, monthly plans can be cancelled any month, and you keep all your files and access.

Do you also host websites?

We can recommend and manage hosting for you, but the hosting account stays in your company name.

What is included in website maintenance?

Updates, backups, security monitoring, uptime and speed checks, small content changes and a monthly report.

Do you offer emergency support?

Yes. Enterprise clients have 24/7 support with a 15-minute response for critical incidents, and care-plan clients get priority handling.

Can you speed up my slow website?

Yes. Speed optimisation covers images, caching, scripts and hosting, and we measure before and after.

Do you support WooCommerce stores?

Yes, including order flow checks after every update.
